cash_flows.rule: Real estate scheduled interest is principal times 6% / 12, copied from the document coupon. A month inside the servicer dpd window is a shortfall. Invoices are a bullet on the document due date. Current-loan accrued interest is earned and not yet due, so it is not a shortfall.

accrued_reconciliation.note: Current real estate loans: fixture accrued is within $50 of one coupon month (day-count stub). Delinquent real estate: residual is fixture accrued minus missed coupons. H-RE-05 is dpd_1_30 in the fixture while accrued is about two coupons; the bucket wins, and the residual is reported rather than forced to zero.

checks.line: documents: pass (enclave). servicer data: anomaly, excluded from TrueVal.
checks.citation: spec/nav/fixtures.json sets anomaly true on M-IN-03 (note: Underwriter flagged a tampered invoice). tee/fixtures/verdicts-368aa2.json records an enclave pass. TrueVal excludes the loan because of the servicer anomaly flag, not because the enclave failed. The blocked double-pledge attempt is a different loan: the H-RE-03 fixture note says Meridian tried to pledge that Harbor property and was blocked.
